# WebsiteToApp — Convert Any Website to an Android App, iOS App, or Windows EXE

> WebsiteToApp.app converts any website URL into a native Android APK/AAB, an iOS app (beta), or a Windows desktop .exe in minutes — no coding required. One-time pricing ($35 per platform), free plan to test, works with WordPress, Shopify, Wix, React, and any custom HTML site.

## What WebsiteToApp Does
- **Website to APK Converter**: Enter a URL, get a signed Android APK ready for install or Play Store
- **Website to Windows EXE**: The same URL becomes a Windows desktop app (.exe installer) — one of the only converters with a desktop output
- **Website to iOS App (beta)**: Cloud-built WKWebView iOS app — unsigned .ipa plus full Xcode source, you publish with your own Apple Developer account
- **No Coding Required**: Works with any website — WordPress, Shopify, Wix, React, plain HTML
- **Native Android Features**: Push notifications, biometric auth, offline mode, file upload, QR scanner, GPS
- **Play Store Ready**: Generates signed AAB (Android App Bundle) ready for Google Play Store submission
- **Customizable Branding**: Custom app icon, splash screen, colors, bottom navigation menu
- **Fast Build**: APK generated in under 5 minutes

## Supported Website Platforms
WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, GoDaddy, Blogger, Weebly, React, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, HTML, PHP, Laravel, Django, Flask, Bubble, Glide, FlutterFlow, Lovable, Bolt.new, v0.dev, Streamlit, Framer, Notion Sites

## Native App Features Available
- Push notifications (Firebase FCM)
- Biometric authentication (fingerprint / face unlock)
- File upload & download
- Camera & QR code scanner
- GPS / location services
- Custom user agent string
- Screenshot prevention
- Offline mode (cache)
- AdMob ad integration
- Bottom navigation menu
- Pull-to-refresh
- External link handling
- JavaScript bridge (WebView)

## Who It's For
- Business owners wanting a mobile app without development cost
- Freelancers and agencies building apps for clients
- No-code builders converting Bubble/Webflow/FlutterFlow projects to apps
- E-commerce stores (Shopify, WooCommerce) wanting a mobile shopping app
- Educators and content creators wanting a branded app

## Pricing (one-time — no subscription, unlike most competitors)
- Free: 5 builds, small watermark, 15-day app trial
- Android App: $35 one-time — signed APK + AAB, no watermark, unique per-app signing keystore, 5 rebuilds/month
- Windows Desktop App (EXE): $35 one-time — WebsiteToApp is one of the only converters with a desktop EXE output
- iOS App (beta): $35 one-time — unsigned .ipa + complete Xcode source project; publish with your own Apple Developer account
- App + Play Store Publishing: $50 one-time — we handle the Google Play listing
- Play Store Listing service alone: $15 one-time
- Pro Monthly add-on (optional): $9/month per app — 20 rebuilds/month instead of 5, priority build queue
- Comparison: WebIntoApp has no desktop option and charges $89 one-time to remove branding; typical app-builder platforms charge $99+/month. Full table: https://websitetoapp.app/alternatives/webintoapp
